constructive_exploration.completeness_scope: all normal refinements and all binary effect partitions for the declared 1-action/1-target/1-role, budgets<=1, rank/depth<=2 transition template

limitations: branch cap is an explicit finite rule-set precondition because zero-budget child neutrality does not derive fan-out from budgets
B_safe is conservative and distinct from exact reachable/execution maxima
action-target pairs remain a Cartesian over-approximation
adapter effect semantics and cutover delay are outside this task
recovery and reconstitution edges are excluded

metric_reached.meaning: maximum cumulative distinct authority objects materialized in one complete lawful execution from the reference root
metric_reached.name: B_execution_reference

measure: (finite_rank, successor_depth_allowance), with both components strictly decreased on every authority-generating edge
scope: finite authority semantics represented by the frozen nine-dimensional Cartesian-overapproximation envelope; synthetic transition/split/join traces only
theorem: For every initial authority A0 in a declared finite envelope domain and finite rule set with branch cap b, if every admitted authority-producing normal/split/join edge strictly lowers frozen finite rank, consumes successor-depth allowance, satisfies frozen M2-T1/T2 local and aggregate conservation, fails closed on undefined comparison, introduces no recovery/reconstitution or external authority, and never resurrects consumed authority, then the represented pre-cutover descendant graph has at most B_nodes(A0) canonical states, each live frontier has at most B_live(A0) nodes, and remaining plus cumulatively spent effect authority never exceeds B_effect(A0).
